🎉 Big launch for the founders of Manifest! After making backend creation simple and fast, the past incubees of Incubateur HEC Paris are back with Okapi: a team of AI agents on call for the APIs your app depends on. 🤖 API providers change their APIs without warning. Your code passes review, your tests pass in staging… and integrations still break in production. With Okapi, every breaking change becomes a pull request: 👀 Monitors third-party APIs used across your GitHub repos ⚠️ Detects retired endpoints, renamed fields and dropped versions 🔄 Opens a PR with the necessary fixes, ready to review and merge The API changes. Your code follows. One-click install. And it’s free. 👏 Congrats to the whole team! 🚀 Follow Okapi to see what’s next. Sebastien Conejo | Bruno Pérez | Antoine Lepretre | [...] 11

##### Transcript

Your app runs several external APIs. Each one can change without telling you. And suddenly one morning your agents are down. One of those APIs, renamed Field Data Items became Data Results, and the response is still a 200. Neither your code reviewer nor your tests could catch it, so your customer told you. Okapi installs on your repo in one click every day. The agents behind API bot scan the APIs your code calls. When one of them ships a breaking change, a pull request lands in your repo. It tells you what broke and shows the fix as a diff. All you have to do is review and merge. Be the one who's integrations never break. Try it today for free.
